headline: Product ramp turns the quarter solidly profitable
summary_short: Ascendis Pharma's Q2 2026 total revenue rose to €339.3 million (+114.7% y/y) as YORVIPATH, SKYTROFA and newly-launched YUVIWEL together drove product revenue up 104.9% y/y, and the quarter swung to a €207.0 million IFRS net profit versus a €38.9 million loss a year earlier.
summary_long: Growth was broad-based: YORVIPATH +144.8% y/y on continued U.S. patient demand and expanded global reimbursement, SKYTROFA +8.9% y/y, and first-quarter YUVIWEL contribution of €7.6 million. IFRS operating profit swung to €220.5 million, helped by product growth plus a €158 million net gain on the sale of a Priority Review Voucher; non-IFRS operating profit (excluding that gain and share-based comp) was €92.0 million versus a year-ago loss. R&D rose 5.4% y/y on higher Endocrinology Rare Disease trial activity, partly offset by lower Oncology spend; SG&A rose 61.1% y/y on commercial expansion. Cash was €812.3 million after €56 million of Q2 buybacks/RSU settlement, and the company converted all $575 million of its 2028 convertible notes to equity in May.
